description: Scrape organic results, ads, knowledge graph, images, and videos from Yandex search.

lang.description: UI language for Yandex search. Affects result language and UI text.
lang.title: Language

lr.description: Yandex region filter. Use named shortcut (e.g. 'ru', 'moscow', 'tr', 'us') or a numeric Yandex region ID.
lr.title: Region

maxPages.description: Maximum number of SERP pages to scrape per query.
maxPages.title: Max Pages Per Query

noReask.description: Disable Yandex's automatic query correction (noreask=1). Use for exact-match searches.
noReask.title: Disable Spell Correction

proxyConfiguration.description: Recommended. Yandex triggers SmartCaptcha on datacenter IPs. Use residential proxies for best results.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

resultsPerPage.description: Number of organic results per page. Yandex supports 10, 20, 30, or 50.
resultsPerPage.title: Results Per Page

searchQueries.description: One or more Yandex search queries. Each query is processed separately.
searchQueries.title: Search Queries

yandexDomain.description: The Yandex regional domain to use. If SmartCaptcha blocks the chosen domain (common on datacenter IPs), the scraper falls back to a captcha-free domain and labels the record via `search_metadata.locale_switched` (the fallback domains render their own country's UI language, e.g. Turkish for yandex.com.tr, even though the organic results stay in your requested language).
yandexDomain.title: Yandex Domain

title: Yandex Search Scraper Input
